import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
ints=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
print('int-valued cols:', all((df[c]%1==0).all() for c in ints))
drop=set()
for k,sub in df.groupby(ints):
    if len(sub)<2: continue
    idx=list(sub.index)
    for i in range(len(idx)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(idx)):
            a,b=sub.loc[idx[i]],sub.loc[idx[j]]
            if abs(a.bmi-b.bmi)<=0.5 and abs(a.diabetes_pedigree-b.diabetes_pedigree)<=0.05 and a.outcome==b.outcome:
                drop.add(idx[j])
print('near-dup rows to drop:', len(drop))
print('exact-dup rows:', df.duplicated().sum())
print('remaining:', len(df)-len(drop))
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
ints=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
sizes=df.groupby(ints).size()
print('group size counts:'); print(sizes.value_counts().sort_index())
db=[];dd=[]
for k,sub in df.groupby(ints):
    if len(sub)<2: continue
    s=sub.values
    for i in range(len(s)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(s)):
            db.append(abs(s[i][5]-s[j][5])); dd.append(abs(s[i][6]-s[j][6]))
db=np.array(db);dd=np.array(dd)
print('bmi diff quantiles', np.quantile(db,[0,.25,.5,.75,.9,1]).round(3))
print('dpf diff quantiles', np.quantile(dd,[0,.25,.5,.75,.9,1]).round(3))
"

import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
ints=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
dup=df.duplicated(subset=ints,keep='first')
print('rows flagged:',dup.sum())
g=df.groupby(ints)['outcome'].nunique()
print('pairs with conflicting outcome:', (g>1).sum())
clean=df[~dup].reset_index(drop=True)
clean.to_csv('/tmp/clean.csv',index=False)
print(clean.shape, clean.outcome.value_counts().to_dict())
